text:
Mira K: Heads up — PR #8124 is blocked until we get architecture review and an RFC sanity check. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-infra/pull/8124 RFC: https://go.redwood.dev/rfc/167-kv-cache-routing. Can someone from arch take a look?

Devon H: Quick summary: this adds cross-shard prefix-aware routing and a small kv-cache layer to reduce duplicate decode work. Main perf tradeoff: +~2ms p99 in our microbench but ~8% token/GPU cost savings in steady state.

Alex P: pinging arch. Also FYI runtime touches `router.go` and routing table changes — we should confirm lock contention risk. Can we get a brief canary plan here?

Julia C: Arch ping @ArchTeam — we need an explicit architecture ack before merge. Please confirm canary %, rollback criteria, and any SLO delta. Also need migration steps for cache invalidation. :eyes:

arch-bot: architecture-review: request received for RFC 167. Assigned: Kevin R. ETA: 24h.

Kevin R: I'll take this. Quick Q: does the change require any cross-region state sync or global coordination? If so we need a migration window.

Devon H: No cross-region sync — this is region-local sharding only. Migration plan is: drain old cache using epoch bump + rollout flag, then enable new routing. Added a migration script: `tools/cache/migrate.sh`.

Alex P: Cool. From runtime side I'd like a CI stress test exercising concurrent route updates + heavy inference to check for lock contention. Can we add a small benchmark in `infra/tests/bench/routing_stress.go`?

Kevin R: Sounds reasonable. Also please add a one-paragraph note in the RFC summarizing fallback behavior (what happens if cache invalidation fails) and the canary metric hooks we expect (latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, tokens/GPU). Once that's in I can give LGTM.

Mira K: Will update RFC with that paragraph and canary plan. Proposed canary: 10% for 6h -> 50% for 12h -> 100% if stable. Rollback triggers: >2% absolute error rate increase OR >5% p99 regression vs baseline.

Julia C: I recommend staged ramping a bit more conservative: 10% for 12h -> 25% for 12h -> 100%. Add explicit rollback runbook steps (who to notify, how to flip the flag, how to force drain).

Devon H: Updated RFC: https://go.redwood.dev/rfc/167-kv-cache-routing (section "Rollout & Rollback" added). Included metrics and a short runbook with commands for flag ops. Rollback thresholds as discussed.

Kevin R: :thumbsup: I'll review the updated RFC now and run quick local bench. Expecting to finish review within a few hours.

Alex P: Noticed CI flake on e2e cache-integration (go 1.20 env). Might be unrelated but re-running CI to be safe.

ci-bot: Re-run requested by Alex P — build queued for PR #8124.

Mira K: Thanks everyone. Unless Kevin flags anything else, we'll wait for his LGTM then schedule the canary during low-traffic window. Tagging @eng-oncall for awareness.

Kevin R: After quick bench, I want one tiny change: add a histogram for routing latency in `runtime/metrics.go` and wire the canary dashboard to it. After that and the RFC note, I can LGTM.

Devon H: Will add the histogram and push a small follow-up commit.

Mira K: OK — leaving this blocked until Kevin's LGTM. Appreciate the quick responses.

Julia C: Thanks folks — appreciate the extra bit of runway for rollout.

Kevin R: LGTM pending the small metrics commit (I'll re-check once CI finishes).
